source.notes: Exploratory pass from a human concept reference. Output canvas is 68x68 square, NOT the approved 64x80 Hunter canvas - reconciliation is Stage 3 (Aseprite) work. Deliberately kept outside apps/ : not wired to the client.

measurements.note: Height runs 0-2px above the approved range; bbox is horizontally centred but drifts 1-2px per direction. Alignment/pivot calibration deferred to Aseprite.

driftFromBrief: Hood is worn UP in all 8 directions; the reference has the hood DOWN with the face and hair visible and the cowl draped over the shoulders.
Green reads brighter/more saturated than the proposed 'moss' family in several frames.
The antler/bone emblem from the reference is not legible at 48px (expected at this scale).
No belt pouch or small backpack (matches the reference, diverges from visual-direction.md).
